name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited
summary: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides third-party administration services for health insurance claims in India and internationally. The company offers MAtrix, a claims administration platform; MAven, a fraud, waste, and abuse prevention platform; MAven IDP, an intelligent document processing platform; MAven Insights, an analytics and decision intelligence platform; MAven Global, a global benefits administration platform; and Network-as-a-Service platform, which provides access to a healthcare provider network.
